pages.title: Passing Data to Functions
pages.content: Parameters are variables listed inside the function's parentheses. When you call the function, you pass arguments — the actual values. You can have multiple parameters separated by commas.

pages.title: Function Parameters
pages.code:
def greet(name):
    print(f"Hello, {name}!")

greet("Alice")   # Hello, Alice!
greet("Bob")     # Hello, Bob!

# Multiple parameters
def add(a, b):
    print(a + b)

add(3, 5)        # 8

pages.title: Quick Check
pages.question: What is 'name' in `def greet(name):`?
pages.explanation: A parameter is the variable in the function definition. The value passed when calling is an argument.
